```{r setup, include=FALSE}

  c(
  "CD8/CD4_T",
  "Naive_B",
  "Memory_B",
  "NK",
  "CD8_T",
  "CD4_T",
  "Th17/CD4_T",

  "CD4_T",

  "Memory_B",

  "CD4_T",
  "memCD4_T",
  "Treg",
  "Other")

proj@cellColData$PredCellType <-
```

# Sample QCs for scATAC-seq datasets

## UMAP clustering for RNA-seq and ATAC-seq
```{r}
p3<-plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "PredCellType", embedding = "UMAP", pal = pal_atac, labelMeans = FALSE) + theme_ArchR(legendTextSize = 15) + theme(legend.position = "none")
p4<-plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj, colorBy = "cellColData", name = "Tissue", embedding = "UMAP", labelMeans = FALSE) + theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r}
seRNA <- readRDS("~/cluster/projects/u19_multiomics/analyses/remove_dup/lungs_spleens_integrated_subSCE.RDS") 
colData(seRNA)$CellType <- factor(
    colData(seRNA)$CellType,
    levels = 
            c("Other", "Treg", "memCD4_T", "naiCD4_T",
              "CD8_T", "NK", "Memory_B", "Naive_B"))
pal <- paletteDiscrete(values = colData(seRNA)$CellType)
rm(seRNA)
```
COB-5 sample has a small cluster of cells with low number of fragments, so top 5K cells ranked by number of fragments were retained. As a result, we see more consistent distribution from the rigid plots of TSS enrichment and log10 of number of fragments across samples. 
```{r message = F}
p1 <- plotGroups(
    ArchRProj = proj, 
    groupBy = "Sample", 
    colorBy = "cellColData", 
    name = "TSSEnrichment",
  plotAs = "ridges",
    baseSize = 12
)

p2 <- plotGroups(
    ArchRProj = proj, 
    groupBy = "Sample", 
    colorBy = "cellColData", 
  name = "log10(nFrags)",
  plotAs = "ridges",
    baseSize = 12
)

ggAlignPlots(p1, p2, type = "h") 
```

Ridge plots for TSS enrichment and log10(nFrags) across samples show a relatively consistent distribution.
```{r eval = F}
#too slow
proj@cellColData$Sample <-

         labels)
p3 <- plotFragmentSizes(ArchRProj = proj)
p4 <- plotTSSEnrichment(ArchRProj = proj)

```

Clustering of ATAC-seq data shows no strong bias to one batch or one sample.


Clustering of ATAC-seq data also shows no distinct clusters for either tissue or disease status.

```{r, message = F, fig.width = 8}
ggAlignPlots(p2, p3, type = "h")
```

# Annotate clusters of scATAC-seq data with majority voting

Majority of clusters were dominated by one single cell type from matched RNA-seq, while two clusters show some ambiguity and so labeled as "CD8/CD4_T" and "Th17/CD4_T".

```{r, message = F, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6}
proj@cellColData$PredCellType <-
  factor(proj@cellColData$PredCellType,
         levels = rev(toshow_ct))
pal_atac <- paletteDiscrete(values = proj@cellColData$PredCellType)

plotEmbedding(ArchRProj = proj, colorBy = "cellColData", 
              name = "Clusters", embedding = "UMAP") + 
 theme_ArchR(legendTextSize = 15, legendPosition = "none")

atac_meta <- readRDS("../output/atac_meta_integration.RDS")
gginput <- data.frame(table(atac_meta$Clusters, atac_meta$RNALabels),
                      colnames = c("Clusters", "Count"))

p1 <-
ggplot(atac_meta,
       aes(x = factor(Clusters, levels = paste0("C", 1:length(unique(Clusters)))),
           fill = RNALabels)) + 
  geom_bar() + 
  xlab("Clusters") + ylab("Count") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_rna) + 
  labs(fill = "RNA-seq labels") + 
  theme_pub(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p2 <- 
  ggplot(unique(atac_meta[, c("Clusters", "SimilarityScore")]),
         aes(x = factor(Clusters, levels = paste0("C", 1:length(unique(Clusters)))),
             y = SimilarityScore)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  xlab("") + ylab("Jaccard index") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 12)

plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol =1, rel_heights  = c(2, 1))

```

```{r}
rnaLabels <- levels(factor(atac_meta_updated$FilteredCellType))
majorityVoting <- 
  atac_meta_updated %>% 
    group_by(Clusters) %>%
      summarise(CellType = rnaLabels[which.max(table(FilteredCellType))])

atac_meta$CellType <- majorityVoting$CellType[match(atac_meta$Clusters, majorityVoting$Clusters)]
```

Comparison of UMAPs before or after majority-voting

* left plot - cell labels before majority-voting

* right plot - cell labels after majority-voting

## Comparing majority voting vs. RNA label transferring

Most of the clusters were annotated similarly using both majority voting or label transferring approaches. For the ambiguous clusters, results from label transferring show C16 was mostly Th17 and C14 was mixture of CD8/CD4_T cells. This is due to imperfect clustering or heterogeneity at chromatin levels for cells in those clusters.

```{r, fig.width = 10}
proj@cellColData$LabelTransfer <- 
  factor(metadata$predictedGroup_Un,
         levels = rev(names(pal)))
p1 <- 
  ggplot(proj@cellColData,
         aes(x = Clusters,
             fill = CellType)) + 
    geom_bar() + 
    #scale_fill_manual(values = pal) + 
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)  + 
    ggtitle("Cells partially annotated by integrative approach")
p2 <-   
ggplot(proj@cellColData,
       aes(x = Clusters,
           fill = LabelTransfer)) + 
  geom_bar() + 
  #scale_fill_manual(values = pal) + 
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + 
  ggtitle("Cells annotated by label transferring")

proj@cellColData$SingleTissue <- 
  factor(proj@cellColData$SingleTissue,
         labels = c("Memory_B", "NK", "NK", "Other", "Other", "Other",
                    "Memory_B", "Naive_B", "Other", "Treg", "CD4_T",
                    "CD8_T", "Th17"))
# Corrected lung cluster 4 to be CD4 T cells
proj@cellColData$correctLabs <- proj@cellColData$CellType
proj@cellColData$correctLabs[which(proj@cellColData$Tissue == "Lung" & proj@cellColData$SeuratCluster == "4")] <- "CD4_T"

p3 <-   
ggplot(proj@cellColData,
       aes(x = Clusters,
           fill = factor(SingleTissue, 
                         levels = levels(factor(proj@cellColData$CellType))))) + 
  geom_bar() + labs(fill = "CellType") + 
  #scale_fill_manual(values = pal) + 
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + 
  ggtitle("Cells partially annotated by single-tissue approach")

p4 <-   
ggplot(proj@cellColData,
       aes(x = Clusters,
           fill = correctLabs)) + 
  geom_bar() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) + 
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + 
  ggtitle("Cells annotated by correct labels")

p5 <-   
ggplot(proj@cellColData,
       aes(x = Clusters,
           fill = correctTransfer)) + 
  geom_bar() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) + 
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + 
  ggtitle("Cells annotated by Transferred labels")

ggAlignPlots(p4, p5, type = "v")
```

### Comparing cell labels from two approaches with Jaccard Index
```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 4}
jaccard <- function(a, b) {
    a <- as.character(a)
    b <- as.character(b)
    intersection = sum(a == b, na.rm = TRUE)
    union = length(a) + length(b) - intersection
    return (c(intersection, union, intersection/union))
}

by_cluster <-
  unlist(lapply(split(atac_meta, atac_meta$Clusters), function(i){
    return(jaccard(i$CellType, i$predictedGroup3_Un)[3])
  }))

atac_meta$SimilarityScore <- by_cluster[match(atac_meta$Clusters,names(by_cluster))]


LabelTransfer <- data.frame(Clusters = clustersDF$Clusters, 
                            CellType = clustersDF$LabelTransfer) 
LabelTransfer <-
  sapply(split(LabelTransfer, LabelTransfer$Clusters), function(i) {
    df = data.frame(table(i))
    return(df$CellType[which.max(df$Freq)])
  })
LabelTransfer <- data.frame(Clusters = names(LabelTransfer), LabelTransfer)
MajorityVote <- data.frame(Clusters = clustersDF$Clusters, 
                            CellType = clustersDF$MajorityVote) %>% distinct()

joint_tbl <- left_join(LabelTransfer, MajorityVote, by = "Clusters")
sum(as.character(joint_tbl$LabelTransfer) == as.character(joint_tbl$CellType))
```

## Track plots for all peaks near TSS of each marker gene 

```{r message = F, eval = F}
library(locuszoomr)
library(glue)
gene <- c("CD19", "MS4A1", "CD80","IGHG1","GNLY", "CD8B","CD4","LEF1", "RORC","CTLA4")
window_size <- 0.1e4
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
edb <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86

loc_list <-
  lapply(gene, function(i){
    locus(gene = i,
	        flank = window_size,
	        ens_db = edb)
  })
names(loc_list) <- gene

gene_tracks <-
  lapply(loc_list, function(i){
    gg_genetracks(i, cex.text = 1, filter_gene_biotype = "protein_coding") + 
#     scale_x_continuous(limits = i$xrange/1e6,
# 		       labels = function(x) round(x, 2),
# 		       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_minimal() + xlab("") + 
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(color = "white", fill = "white"))
  }) 

names(gene_tracks) <- gene
# Atac-seq peaks
bigwigs <- "../output/u19_multiomics/analyses/u19_peaks_tissue/GroupBigWigs/CellGroup/" |>
    list.files(full.name = TRUE, pattern = "*.bw")

names(bigwigs) <- 
    unlist(lapply(basename(bigwigs), function(i){strsplit(i, "-")[[1]][1]}))

loc_DF <- data.frame(
  t(sapply(loc_list, function(i){c(i$seqname, i$xrange[1], i$xrange[2])}))) 

plot_list <- list()
for(loc in loc_list){
  interv <- GRanges(glue("chr{loc$seqname}"), IRanges(loc$xrange[1], loc$xrange[2]))

  atac_ranges <- map(bigwigs[1:9], ~import(., which = interv)) 
  
  atac_covered <-
      atac_ranges |>
      map_dfr(~as.data.frame(.) |> as_tibble(), .id = "CellType") |>
      dplyr::select(CellType, start, end, score) %>%
      mutate(CellType = gsub("Lung_", "", CellType))
  
  atac_gaps <- 
      atac_ranges |>
      map_dfr(~ranges(.) |> gaps() |> as.data.frame() |> as_tibble(), .id = "CellType") |>
      mutate(score = 0) |>
      dplyr::select(CellType, start, end, score)
  
  atac_peaks <- 
      bind_rows(atac_covered, atac_gaps) |>
      arrange(CellType, start) |>
      pivot_longer(start:end, names_to = "dummy", values_to = "pos") |>
      dplyr::filter(CellType != "Other") |>
      mutate(CellType = factor(CellType,
                               levels = gsub("/", ".", ct_order),
                               labels = ct_order))
  
  
  atac_plot <- 
      ggplot(atac_peaks %>%
               mutate(CellType = factor(CellType, levels = ct_order2))) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(x = pos, ymin = 0, ymax = score, 
                      color = CellType, fill = CellType),
  		linewidth = .5, outline.type = "full", alpha = .5) +
      scale_x_continuous(
             limits = loc$xrange, 
  		       labels = function(x) round(x/1e6L, 2),
  		       expand = c(0, 0)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = pal_atac) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = pal_atac) +
      facet_wrap(~ CellType, ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
  	  legend.position = "none",
  	  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
  	  axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
  	  #strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, size = 12),
  	  strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
  	  panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  	  panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
  	  panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
  	  panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
  	  plot.background = element_rect(color = "white", fill = "white")) +
      labs(x = NULL)

    plot_list[[loc$gene]] <- 
        plot_grid(gene_tracks[[loc$gene]], atac_plot, rel_heights  = c(0.2, 1),
                  ncol = 1)
}
```

## Peak accessibility heatmap by cell type

```{r}
# Add Seurat cluster from the matched rna to the archR object
rnameta <- read.csv("output/lung_spleen_metadata.csv")
rnameta$core_ID <- factor(rnameta$full.ident, 
                          labels = c(paste0("SMO", "-", c(2,3,5,7,8,9)),
                                     paste0("SMO", "-", c(1, 4, 10))))
rnameta$CellBarcode <-paste(rnameta$core_ID, gsub("-", "_", rownames(rnameta)), sep = "#")
rnameta$CellBarcode <- unlist(lapply(rnameta$CellBarcode, function(i) {strsplit(i, "_")[[1]][1]}))
atacmeta <- 
  data.frame(proj@cellColData) %>% 
    mutate(CellBarcode = unlist(lapply(rownames(proj@cellColData), function(i) {paste(strsplit(i, "-")[[1]][1:2], collapse = "-")})))
atacmeta <- left_join(atacmeta, rnameta[, c("CellBarcode", "wsnn_MajorityVoting", "integrated_snn_res.0.5")]) #seurat_clusters
proj@cellColData$SeuratCluster <- atacmeta$integrated_snn_res.0.5
proj@cellColData$wsnn_MajorityVoting <- atacmeta$wsnn_MajorityVoting

# First, get marker peaks per cell type/cluster
markersPeaks <- getMarkerFeatures(
  ArchRProj = proj,
  useMatrix = "PeakMatrix",
  groupBy = "PredCellType",
  bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"),
  testMethod = "wilcoxon"
)

# Change the order of y-axis labels
if (!is.null(y_axis_label)) {
  markersPeaks = markersPeaks[, y_axis_label]
}

# Then plot the heatmap
heatmapPeaks <- plotMarkerHeatmap(seMarker = markersPeaks,
                                  cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 1",
                                  transpose = TRUE)

# Draw it
ComplexHeatmap::draw(heatmapPeaks, heatmap_legend_side = "bot")

ArchRProj <-
  addMotifAnnotations(ArchRProj, motifSet = "cisbp", name = "Motif")

enrichMotifs <- peakAnnoEnrichment(
  seMarker = markersPeaks,
  ArchRProj = proj[proj@cellColData$PredCellType != "Other"],
  peakAnnotation = "Motif",
  cutOff = "FDR <= 0.1 & Log2FC >= 0.58"
)

colnames(enrichMotifs)[7] <- "memCD4_T"
heatmapEM <-
  plotEnrichHeatmap(enrichMotifs, n = 15, transpose = TRUE)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  heatmapEM,
  heatmap_legend_side = "bot",
  annotation_legend_side = "bot",
  row_order = toshow_ct[1:8]
)

# output enriched motifs into a data frame
library(SummarizedExperiment)

# one assay (first by default, or name it)
mat <- assay(se)                  # or assay(se, "counts")
df  <- as.data.frame(mat)

# keep row names as a column
df <- data.frame(feature = rownames(mat), mat, check.names = FALSE)
# Or save it as a PDF
plotPDF(heatmapPeaks, name = "Peak-Marker-Heatmap_review", 
          width = 8, height = 6, ArchRProj = proj, addDOC = FALSE)
```

```{r}
df <- data.frame(TF = rownames(enrichMotif), mlog10Padj = assay(motifsUp)[,1])
df <- df[order(df$mlog10Padj, decreasing = TRUE),]
df$rank <- seq_len(nrow(df))
```
